item.title: President Lee: "Those Responsible for Ballot Shortages Must Be Held Accountable...Local Election Results Humbly Accepted" (李대통령 “투표용지 부족 책임 물어야...지선 결과는 겸허히 받아들여”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Those Responsible for Ballot Shortages Must Be Held Accountable...Local Election Results Humbly Accepted" (李대통령 “투표용지 부족 책임 물어야...지선 결과는 겸허히 받아들여”)

On the fourth day, marking his first anniversary in office, President Lee Jae-myung presided over a senior secretaries' meeting at the Blue House and stated regarding the results of the 9th nationwide local elections held the previous day, "I express very deep regret over the occurrence of problems related to the people's sacred right to vote." (이재명 대통령은 취임 1주년을 맞은 4일 청와대에서 수석보좌관회의를 주재하고, 전날 치러진 제9회 전국동시지방선거 결과와 관련해 “국민의 신성한 참정권과 관련해 문제가 발생한 점에 대해 매우 큰 유감을 표한다”고 밝혔다.)

He further addressed the relevant agencies, saying, "The administration must use all its authority and responsibility to clearly identify the cause of the problem, and if there are those to hold accountable, accountability must be clearly enforced." He added, "I ask that reliable and appropriate measures be promptly established to ensure that no incidents undermining the people's right to vote happen again." At some polling stations, including the second polling station in Jamshil 7-dong, Seoul, a shortage of ballots on the 3rd prevented some voters from participating in the election. (이어 관계기관을 향해 “행정부가 가진 권한과 책임을 모두 사용해서 문제 발생 이유를 명확하게 밝히고, 또 책임질 것이 있다면 명확하게 책임을 물어야 하겠다”며 “국민의 참정권이 한 치라도 훼손되는 일이 다시는 발생하지 않도록 신뢰할 만한 적절한 대책을 조속하게 마련해 주기 바란다”고 했다. 서울 잠실7동 제2투표소 등 일부 투표소는 3일 투표용지가 부족해 일부 투표자가 선거에 참여하지 못하는 일이 발생했다.)

He also emphasized political cooperation after the election. President Lee stated, "Regardless of the competition during the election process, both the ruling and opposition parties are partners who must represent the sovereign people to protect their livelihoods and pioneer a better future for the nation." He urged, "I ask the political circles to join forces to achieve the substantive improvements in living standards, balanced regional development, and national unity mandated by the sovereign people." (선거 이후 정국의 협치도 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “선거 과정에서의 경쟁이 어떠했든 여야는 모두 주권자를 대리해서 국민의 삶을 지키고 국가의 더 나은 내일을 개척해야 할 동반자들”이라며 “정치권도 주권자가 명령한 실질적인 민생 개선과 지역균형발전, 그리고 국민통합에 함께 힘을 모아달라”고 당부했다.)

Declaring that the second year of the people's sovereignty government had begun as of that day, President Lee ordered public officials, "Tighten your shoelaces once again and devote all efforts to accelerating the pace of state affairs." In particular, he instructed a preemptive review of summer disaster safety measures coinciding with the transition period for local government launches. President Lee noted, "This summer is expected to have higher temperatures and more precipitation than average, and there are concerns about a vacuum in local government administrative leadership due to the local elections." (이날로 국민주권 정부의 2년 차 임기가 시작됐음을 선언한 이 대통령은 공직자들에게 “신발끈을 다시 한번 단단히 묶고 국정 속도 배가에 총력을 기울여 달라”고 주문했다. 특히 지방정부 출범 전환기와 맞물린 여름철 재난 안전 대책을 선제적으로 점검할 것을 지시했다. 이 대통령은 “올여름은 평년보다 기온이 높고 강수량도 많을 것으로 전망되는 데다, 지방선거로 인해 지방정부의 행정 리더십 공백까지 우려되는 상황”이라고 짚었다.)

President Lee said, "From now, at the start of summer, we must mobilize all available means to prevent disasters such as heatstroke, flooding, landslides, retaining wall collapses, sinkholes, and suffocation in confined spaces." He added, "Conduct meticulous pre-inspections of risk areas such as construction sites and aging public facilities." He continued, "When it comes to matters of people's lives, please respond with a strength that might seem excessive." (이 대통령은 “여름의 초입인 지금부터 열사병, 수해, 산사태, 축대 붕괴, 땅꺼짐(싱크홀), 밀폐 공간 질식사 같은 재해 예방의 가용 수단을 총동원해야 한다”며 “공사장이나 노후 공공 시설 등 위험 지역에 대해 사전에 치밀한 점검을 진행하라”고 했다. 이어 “국민의 생명에 관한 문제만큼은 과하다 싶을 정도로 강력하게 대응해 달라”고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Wins 12 Areas vs. Opposition’s 4, Seoul Handed Over in Half Victory…By-election Result 9 to 4 (與 12곳 vs 野 4곳, 서울 내줘 절반의 승리…재보선은 9 대 4)
item.description:
Ruling Party Wins 12 Areas vs. Opposition’s 4, Seoul Handed Over in Half Victory…By-election Result 9 to 4 (與 12곳 vs 野 4곳, 서울 내줘 절반의 승리…재보선은 9 대 4)

In the 9th nationwide local elections for metropolitan government heads, the Democratic Party of Korea won in 12 areas, while the People Power Party won in 4 areas. (제9회 전국동시지방선거 광역단체장 선거에서 더불어민주당이 12곳, 국민의힘이 4곳에서 승리했다.)

According to the vote count results from the National Election Commission, the Democratic Party secured 12 areas including Gyeonggi, Incheon, Gangwon, North Chungcheong, South Chungcheong, Daejeon, Sejong, North Jeolla, the Integrated Special City of South Jeolla-Gwangju, South Jeolla, and Jeju, while the People Power Party secured 4 areas: Seoul, Daegu, North Gyeongsang, and South Gyeongsang. In the 8th local elections in 2022, the People Power Party won in 12 areas and the Democratic Party in 5 areas. <<> Han Byeong-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader, said at a policy coordination meeting that morning regarding the results, including the loss in the Seoul mayoral election, "The Democratic Party takes the people's will seriously." He added, "Voter interest and participation were so high that it recorded the highest turnout since the 1st local elections in 1995," and "The people have given us a stern command to be more humble before public sentiment and to swiftly improve livelihoods, which is also a heavy task." He further stated, "The Democratic Party will fully uphold the people's will." <<> In the Seoul mayoral election, People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon received 48.94%, while Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh received 48.34%. As of 9:30 AM, the vote count rate was 97.7%, and the gap between the two candidates was 0.60 percentage points (30,359 votes). <<> In the Gyeonggi Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Choo Mi-ae received 55.04%, while People Power Party candidate Yang Hyang-ja received 39.37%. In the Incheon mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Park Chan-dae received 52.84%, while People Power Party candidate Yoo Jeong-bok received 46.06%. <<> In the Busan mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo received 50.52%, while People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon received 47.90%. In the Ulsan mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook received 48.73%, while People Power Party candidate Kim Doo-gyeom received 45.74%. In the South Gyeongsang Province governor election, People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo received 51.52%, while Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo received 48.47%. <<> In the Daegu mayoral election, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho received 53.92%, while Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum received 45.05%. In the North Gyeongsang Province governor election, People Power Party candidate Lee Cheol-woo received 67.24%, while Democratic Party candidate Oh Jung-ki received 32.75%. <<> In the North Chungcheong Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Shin Yong-han received 54.57%, while People Power Party candidate Kim Young-hwan received 45.42%. In the South Chungcheong Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Park Soo-hyun received 52.53%, while People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-heum received 47.46%. In the Daejeon mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Heo Tae-jeong received 53.48%, while People Power Party candidate Lee Jang-woo received 44.15%. In the Sejong mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Jo Sang-ho received 61.03%, while People Power Party candidate Choi Min-ho received 36.01%. <<> In the Gangwon Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Woo Sang-ho received 51.81%, while People Power Party candidate Kim Jin-tae received 48.18%. In the North Jeolla Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek received 51.22%, while independent candidate Kim Gwan-young received 41.78%. In the Integrated Special City of South Jeolla-Gwangju mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Min Hyeong-bae received 79.01%, while People Power Party candidate Lee Jeong-hyeon received 11.68%. In the Jeju governor election, Democratic Party candidate Wi Seong-gon received 63.11%, while People Power Party candidate Moon Seong-yu received 33.56%. <<> In the by-elections for National Assembly members, the Democratic Party won in 9 areas, while the People Power Party won in 4 areas. I am grateful and respect the wise choices of the people. item.title: A Single Vote Decided the Outcome... Nonsan Chungcheongnam-do Council Election (단 1표가 당락 갈랐다... 논산 충남도의원 선거)
item.description:
A Single Vote Decided the Outcome... Nonsan Chungcheongnam-do Council Election (단 1표가 당락 갈랐다... 논산 충남도의원 선거)

In the Nonsan City First Electoral District for electing Chungcheongnam-do council members, Democratic Party candidate Ki Ho-yeop won by a margin of one vote. Candidate Ki received 11,594 votes (50%), defeating People Power Party candidate Yoon Ki-hyung, who garnered 11,593 votes (49.99%). As of around 4 a.m. on the 4th, the completed counting showed candidates Ki and Yoon tied at 11,592 votes each. (충남도의원을 뽑는 논산시 제1선거구에서는 더불어민주당 기호엽 후보가 1표 차로 당선됐다. 기 후보는 1만1594표(50%)를 얻어 1만1593표(49.99%)를 얻은 국민의힘 윤기형 후보를 이겼다. 4일 오전 4시쯤 완료된 개표 결과에서는 기 후보와 윤 후보가 1만1592표를 얻어 동점이었다.)

The Nonsan City Election Commission postponed the finalization of the winner and conducted a manual recount. During the recount, which lasted about three hours, two additional valid votes for Candidate Ki and one additional valid vote for Candidate Yoon were recognized from previously invalid ballots, resulting in a one-vote difference. Winner Ki stated, "Having received the support of each and every citizen I met and winning by just one vote, I take this very seriously. I will conduct my legislative activities with greater humility and diligence." (논산시선거관리위원회는 당선인 확정을 보류하고 수작업으로 재검표를 진행했다. 3시간가량 진행된 재검표에서는 기존 무효표 중 기 후보 유효표 2표, 윤 후보 유효표 1표가 각각 추가로 인정되면서 1표 차 승부가 나왔다. 기 당선인은 “그동안 만났던 한 분, 한 분의 시민 지지를 받아 단 1표 차이로 당선됐기 때문에 엄중하게 생각한다”면서 “더 겸손하고 열심히 의정 활동을 하겠다”고 말했다.)

Looking at past cases, when the vote difference is minimal, a re-count may proceed through a petition for invalidation of the election result, so the possibility of Candidate Yoon’s side filing such a petition cannot be ruled out. (과거 사례를 보면 표 차이가 적을 경우 ‘당선인 결정 무효 확인 소청’을 통한 재개표가 진행되는 경우가 있어 윤 후보 측이 소청을 제기할 가능성을 배제할 수 없다.)

In the 2018 Chungcheongnam-do Cheongyang County Council election, a one-vote difference led to petitions and lawsuits, causing the winner to change repeatedly. At that time, independent candidate Kim Jong-kwan and Democratic Party candidate Lim Sang-gi received 1,398 and 1,397 votes, respectively. In response, Candidate Lim filed a petition for invalidation of the election result with the election commission, and during the recount, one vote from invalid ballots was recognized as valid for Candidate Lim. The vote count became equal, but under the Public Official Election Act, the winner changed to Candidate Lim, who was older. (지난 2018년 충남 청양군의원 선거에서는 1표 차 승부가 소청과 소송으로 이어지면서 당선인이 계속 바뀌는 상황이 발생했다. 당시 무소속 김종관 후보와 더불어민주당 임상기 후보가 각각 1398표, 1397표를 얻었다. 이에 임 후보는 선관위에 당선인 결정 무효 확인 소청을 제기했고, 재개표에서 임 후보가 무효표 중 1표를 유효표로 인정받았다. 득표수는 같아졌지만 공직선거법에 따라 연장자인 임 후보로 당선인이 바뀌었다.)

However, Candidate Kim filed a lawsuit in court to invalidate the election result. The court recognized one invalid vote as valid for Candidate Kim and invalidated one valid vote for Candidate Lim, resulting in Kim with 1,399 votes and Lim with 1,397 votes. (하지만 김 후보가 법원에 당선인 결정 무효 확인 소송을 제기했고, 법원은 무효표 중 1표를 김 후보의 유효표로 인정했고, 임 후보의 유효표 1표를 무효 처리하면서 김 후보 1399표, 임 후보 1397표로 인정했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] National Election Commission Establishes "Ballot Shortage Fact-Finding Committee" ([속보] 중앙선관위 “‘투표지 부족 사태 진상규명위’ 설치”)
item.description:
[Breaking News] National Election Commission Establishes "Ballot Shortage Fact-Finding Committee" ([속보] 중앙선관위 “‘투표지 부족 사태 진상규명위’ 설치”)

The National Election Commission announced on the 4th that it will establish a "Ballot Shortage Fact-Finding Committee" composed of external experts regarding the ballot shortage that occurred at some polling stations in Seoul on the day of the main vote for the June 3 local elections. (중앙선거관리위원회는 4일 6·3 지방선거 본투표 당일 서울 일부 투표소에서 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 것과 관련해 외부 전문가로 구성된 ‘투표지 부족 사태 진상규명위원회’를 설치하겠다고 밝혔다.)

The commission issued a press release on the same day, stating, "We once again apologize for causing significant confusion and inconvenience to voters in exercising their right to participate in politics." The commission added, "Through a plenary session held early on the 4th, we decided to make every possible effort to immediately investigate the cause of this incident and prepare measures to prevent recurrence as soon as the vote counting for the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections is completed." (선관위는 이날 보도자료를 내고 “유권자들의 참정권 행사에 많은 혼란과 불편을 드린 점에 대해 거듭 사과드린다”면서 이같이 밝혔다. 선관위는 “4일 새벽 개최된 전체위원회의를 통해 제9회 전국동시지방선거의 개표가 종료되는대로 즉시 이번 사태에 대한 진상 규명 및 재발방지 대책을 마련하기 위해 가능한 최선의 노력을 다 하기로 결정한 바 있다”고 했다.)

The commission explained, "First, we will analyze the voting records of the relevant polling stations and confirm the on-site situation at the time from poll managers and clerks. Additionally, we will establish and operate a fact-finding committee, mainly composed of external experts, to identify the causes of the ballot shortage and prepare measures to prevent recurrence." It further stated, "Through the fact-finding committee, we will thoroughly examine the identified problems, causes, and responsibilities, and disclose all results to the public in detail." (선관위는 “먼저 해당 투표소의 투표록 등을 분석하고 투표관리관 및 사무원 등으로부터 당시 현장 상황을 확인할 예정”이라며 “아울러 투표지 부족 사태 원인 파악과 재발 방지 대책 마련을 위하여 외부전문가 위주로 구성한 진상규명위를 설치·운영한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “진상규명위원회를 통해 파악한 문제점과 원인, 책임을 철저히 따져 국민께 모든 결과를 소상히 밝힐 예정”이라고 했다.)

Additionally, the commission said it is visiting the 2nd polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, to persuade citizens who are blocking the removal of ballot boxes. Since yesterday, when a ballot shortage occurred at the 2nd polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, citizens have gathered to protest after commission staff attempted to remove the ballot boxes, leading to a standoff between the commission and citizens that continues to this day. (또 선관위는 서울 송파구 잠실7동 제2투표소를 방문해 투표함 반출을 막고 있는 시민들을 설득 중이라고 밝혔다. 전날 잠실7동 제2투표소에선 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생했는데도 선관위 직원들이 투표함을 반출하려고 하자 이에 항의하는 시민들이 몰려들면서, 선관위와 시민들이 이날까지 대치 중이다.)

item.title: People Power Party holds on to Yangsan, home of former President Moon's private residence... Na Dong-yeon succeeds in a 'stepping-stone' fourth term (‘文 사저’ 양산 지켜낸 국힘... 나동연, 징검다리 4선 성공)
item.description:
People Power Party holds on to Yangsan, home of former President Moon's private residence... Na Dong-yeon succeeds in a 'stepping-stone' fourth term (‘文 사저’ 양산 지켜낸 국힘... 나동연, 징검다리 4선 성공)

In the June 3 local election for Yangsan Mayor in South Gyeongsang Province, incumbent People Power Party (PPP) candidate Na Dong-yeon (71) succeeded in securing a 'stepping-stone' fourth term with a late comeback. Notably, he is the only PPP candidate to win in the so-called 'Nakdong River Belt,' an area where the Democratic Party typically shows competitiveness. (6·3 경남 양산시장 선거에서 국민의힘 후보인 나동연(71) 현 시장이 막판 뒤집기로 징검다리 4선에 성공했다. 특히 민주당이 경쟁력을 보이는 이른바 ‘낙동강 벨트’에서 유일하게 국민의힘 후보로 당선됐다.)

In this one-on-one election, candidate Na won with 51.04% of the vote, defeating Democratic Party candidate Jo Mun-gwan (71) who received 48.95%. The margin between the two candidates was 3,789 votes. (나 후보는 1대1로 치러진 이번 선거에서 51.04%의 득표율로, 민주당 조문관(71) 후보(48.95%)를 꺾고 당선을 확정했다. 두 사람의 표차는 3789표였다.)

President-elect Na has become a 'stepping-stone four-term mayor,' following his previous terms in 2010, 2014, and 2022. This marks the first time a four-term mayor has been elected in Yangsan since the implementation of the local autonomy system. (나 당선인은 2010년과 2014년, 2022년에 이어 ‘징검다리 4선 시장’이 됐다. 민선 지방자치제가 시행된 이후 양산에서 4선 시장이 나오는 건 처음이다.)

President-elect Na stated, "Now is the time for all citizens, both those who supported me and those who did not, to join forces and move forward," adding, "I will proceed with and complete projects to shape Yangsan's future without a hitch." (나 당선인은 “저를 지지한 시민, 지지하지 않은 시민 모두 힘을 모아 앞으로 나아가야 할 때”라며 “양산의 미래를 만들어갈 프로젝트를 차질 없이 진행해 완성하겠다”고 했다.)

Yangsan, with a population of around 360,000, is home to the private residence of former President Moon Jae-in. It is classified as part of the 'Nakdong River Belt,' along with Gimhae in South Gyeongsang and Busan's Buk-gu, Gangseo-gu, Sasang-gu, and Saha-gu, where the Democratic Party has demonstrated competitiveness. In this election, all areas of the Nakdong River Belt except Yangsan elected Democratic Party candidates. (인구 36만여 명의 양산은 문재인 전 대통령 사저가 있는 곳이다. 경남 김해, 부산 북구·강서구·사상구·사하구와 함께 민주당이 경쟁력을 보이는 ‘낙동강 벨트’로 분류된다. 이번 선거에서 양산을 제외한 낙동강 벨트는 모두 민주당 후보가 당선됐다.)

Early in the election, there were predictions that the Democratic Party candidate would have an advantage in Yangsan due to the high approval ratings of the Lee Jae-myung administration. However, as the election drew near, candidate Na leveraged his long administrative experience and name recognition to compete with Democratic candidate Jo. (선거 초반엔 이재명 정부의 국정 지지도가 높은 만큼 양산도 민주당 후보가 유리할 것이란 관측이 나왔다. 그런데 선거가 임박하면서 나 후보가 오랜 시정 경험을 통한 인지도를 앞세워 민주당 조 후보와 경쟁했다.)

Notably, political analysts in the region suggest that "former President Park Geun-hye's visit to Yangsan's Nambu Market on May 27, where she campaigned alongside candidate Na, seems to have influenced the consolidation of the conservative base in the final stages." (특히 지역 정가에선 “지난달 27일 박근혜 전 대통령이 양산 남부시장을 찾아 나 후보와 함께 유세에 나서면서 막판 보수층 결집에 영향을 준 것 같다”는 분석이 나왔다.)

President-elect Na, a native of Yangsan, graduated from Busan Dong-A High School and Pusan National University's Graduate School of International Studies. He previously ran an environmental facility company before entering politics. He first won a seat on the Yangsan City Council as an independent in 2002. In 2010, he was elected mayor of Yangsan as a candidate for the Grand National Party (the predecessor of the PPP) and was re-elected in the 2014 local elections. He lost his bid for a third term in 2018, trailing Democratic candidate Kim Il-kwon by 12 percentage points. He also faced defeat in the 2020 general election (for the Yangsan-eul constituency). However, he made a comeback by running for mayor again in 2022 and winning a third term. (양산이 고향인 나 당선인은 부산 동아고등학교와 부산대 국제전문대학원을 졸업했다. 환경 시설 업체를 운영한 기업인 출신이다. 2002년 무소속으로 양산시의원에 당선되면서 정치에 입문했다. 2010년 한나라당(국민의힘의 전신) 후보로 양산시장에 출마해 당선됐고, 2014년 지방선거에서 재선에 성공했다. 2018년 민주당 김일권 후보에게 12%포인트 차로 패해 3선에 실패했다. 2020년 총선(양산을)에서도 고배를 마셨다. 하지만 2022년 다시 양산시장 선거에 출마해 3선에 성공하며 재기했다.)

In this election, President-elect Na pledged to construct a tunnel connecting Sangbuk and Ulsang to bridge the east-west divide in living areas. He also stated, "I will develop the Pusan National University Yangsan Campus, which has been left as an empty lot for 20 years, into a biomedical R&D (research and development) complex." (나 당선인은 이번 선거에서 동서로 단절된 생활권을 연결하기 위해 상북~웅상 간 터널을 건설하겠다고 공약했다. 또 “20년간 빈터로 방치돼 있는 부산대 양산캠퍼스를 바이오메디컬 R&D(연구·개발) 복합 단지로 개발하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Focus on Public Stability and New Industry Development"... Park Wan-soo, Re-elected Governor of South Gyeongsang Province, Returns to Duty (“민생안정·신산업 육성 집중”...재선 성공 박완수 경남지사, 직무 복귀)
item.description:
"Focus on Public Stability and New Industry Development"... Park Wan-soo, Re-elected Governor of South Gyeongsang Province, Returns to Duty (“민생안정·신산업 육성 집중”...재선 성공 박완수 경남지사, 직무 복귀)

After a tight race that ended in his re-election, South Gyeongsang Province Governor Park Wan-soo returned to duty on the 4th, urging efforts for public stability and the cultivation of new industries. (접전 끝에 재선에 성공한 박완수 경남도지사가 4일 직무에 복귀하며 민생 안정과 신산업 육성을 당부했다.)

Governor Park marked his return to duty by presiding over a tea-time meeting with senior officials at the South Gyeongsang Provincial Government building around 9:50 a.m. that day. The meeting was arranged to minimize administrative gaps caused by the election campaign following his declaration of candidacy on April 27 and to immediately reflect opinions gathered from residents on the ground into policy. Governor Park proposed public stability and securing future growth engines as the core tasks for the 9th popular election provincial administration, set to begin on July 1. (박 지사는 이날 오전 9시 50분쯤 경남도청에서 간부 공무원과 티타임 회의를 주재한 것을 시작으로 직무 복귀를 알렸다. 이날 자리는 지난 4월 27일 출마 선언 이후 선거운동에 따른 도정 공백을 최소화하고, 현장에서 수렴한 도민 의견을 정책에 즉각 반영하기 위해 마련했다. 박 지사는 오는 7월 1일부터 시작할 민선 9기 도정 핵심 과제로 민생 안정과 미래 성장 동력 확보를 제시했다.)

While reviewing the recent completion of a resident living subsidy payment status, he emphasized the importance of maintaining sound fiscal discipline. "South Gyeongsang Province was able to provide living subsidies without additional debt through efficient financial management," said Governor Park. "Please push forward with public stability policies for the common people and vulnerable groups as the top priority." (최근 완료된 도민 생활 지원금 지급 현황을 점검하면서 건전 재정 기조의 중요성을 강조했다. 박 지사는 “경남도가 재정을 효율적으로 운영해 추가 채무 없이 생활 지원금을 지급할 수 있었다”며 “서민과 취약 계층을 위한 민생 안정 정책을 최우선 과제로 추진해 달라”고 했다.)

He also stated his intention to accelerate efforts to strengthen the competitiveness of existing core industries and foster new industries that will lead the future. In particular, he outlined a policy to develop Physical Artificial Intelligence (AI), Small Modular Reactors (SMR), and the content/software industry as key future industries. He also mentioned the need to transition the administrative system to address the climate crisis. "Climate change leads not only to heatwaves but also to ecosystem changes and various social risk factors," Governor Park emphasized, calling for a shift from reactive post-incident measures to a proactive and preemptive response system. He also said he would actively incorporate good policies from rival Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo into the provincial administration. (기존 주력 산업의 경쟁력을 강화하고 미래를 책임질 신산업 육성에도 속도를 내겠다고 했다. 특히 피지컬 인공지능(AI), 소형 모듈 원자로(SMR), 콘텐츠·소프트웨어 산업을 미래 핵심 산업으로 육성하겠다는 방침을 밝혔다. 기후 위기에 대응한 행정 체계 전환의 필요성도 언급했다. 박 지사는 “기후 변화가 폭염뿐 아니라 생태계 변화와 각종 사회적 위험 요인으로 이어진다”며 사후 수습이 아닌 선제적이고 능동적인 대응 체계로의 전환을 강조했다. 선거 과정에서 경쟁한 더불어민주당 김경수 후보의 좋은 정책들은 도정에 적극 수용하겠다고도 했다.)

"I will not forget the opinions given by residents during the election period and will administer the province with a renewed sense of purpose," he said. "Now that the election is over, I ask all public officials to focus solely on the residents and regional development and actively pursue administrative innovation." (그는 “선거 기간 도민들께서 주신 의견을 잊지 않고 초심을 유지하며 도정에 임하겠다”며 “선거가 마무리된 만큼 모든 공직자가 도민과 지역 발전만을 바라보며 적극적인 행정 혁신에 나서 달라”고 했다.)

The June 3rd South Gyeongsang Province gubernatorial election, a face-off between the incumbent and a former governor, was a nail-biter. People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo won with 51.28% of the vote, defeating Democratic Party candidate and former governor Kim Kyoung-soo, who received 48.71%, securing re-election. Governor Park is the only incumbent member of the People's Power Party among those elected to metropolitan and provincial government heads in Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang Province in 2022 to be re-elected. (전·현직 지사의 맞대결로 치러진 6·3 경남지사 선거는 피 말리는 접전이 이어졌다. 국민의힘 박완수 당선인은 득표율 51.28%를 얻어, 48.71% 득표율의 더불어민주당 김경수 전 지사를 제치고 재선에 성공했다. 지난 2022년 부산·울산·경남 광역단체장에 당선된 국민의힘 현직 중 재선에 성공한 것은 박 지사가 유일하다.)

Even as recently as the exit polls announced by three major terrestrial broadcasters at 6 p.m. the previous day, the Park campaign was gloomy, as it was predicted he would trail Kim by 8.6 percentage points. (전날 오후 6시 지상파 방송 3사의 출구 조사가 발표됐을 때만 해도 박 후보 선거 캠프는 침울했다. 김 후보에게 8.6%포인트 뒤지는 것으로 예측됐기 때문이다.)

However, as the counting of in-person ballots got fully underway in the middle of the count, the two candidates engaged in a back-and-forth tight race. From around midnight, Governor Park began to edge ahead by a narrow margin, and the outcome only became clear on the morning of the 4th. (하지만 개표 중반 본투표함 개표가 본격화되면서 두 후보가 역전에 재역전을 거듭하는 박빙 승부를 펼쳤다. 자정 무렵부터 박 지사가 미세한 차이로 치고 나갔고, 4일 아침이 되어서야 승부의 윤곽이 드러났다.)

In this election, the winning candidate Park prominently highlighted the achievements of the 8th popular election provincial administration. He cited a 42-month consecutive trade surplus, ranking first among non-capital regions in Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP), the nation's first introduction of the South Gyeongsang Province Resident Pension, and the establishment of the Korea AeroSpace Administration (KASA) as key accomplishments. In the final stages of the election, he focused on consolidating the conservative vote. He appealed, "At least local governments must maintain balance," and urged, "By the power of the residents, please protect liberal democracy, the rule of law, and the future of South Gyeongsang Province." (박 당선인은 이번 선거에서 민선 8기 도정 성과를 전면에 내세웠다. 무역수지 42개월 연속 흑자, 지역내총생산(GRDP) 비수도권 1위, 전국 최초 경남도민연금 도입, 우주항공청 개청 등을 대표 성과로 제시했다. 선거 막판에는 보수층 결집에 공을 들였다. 그는 “지방정부만큼은 균형을 유지해야 한다”며 “도민의 힘으로 자유민주주의와 법치주의, 경남의 미래를 지켜달라”고 호소했다.)

Former President Park Geun-hye's two visits to South Gyeongsang Province for campaign support in the final stages of the election are cited as a factor that consolidated the conservative vote. (선거 막판 박근혜 전 대통령이 경남을 두 차례 찾아 지원 유세에 나서면서 보수층 결집이 이뤄진 요인으로 꼽힌다.)

Winning in Changwon, considered the elected candidate Park's political hometown, played a particularly significant role. Changwon, with a population of one million, was the biggest battleground, concentrated with 30% of South Gyeongsang Province's voters. Candidate Park defeated candidate Kim in Changwon by a margin of nearly 30,000 votes. (특히 박 당선인의 정치적 고향으로 꼽히는 창원에서 승리한 것이 큰 역할을 했다. 인구 100만의 창원은 경남 유권자 30%가 몰린 최대 격전지였다. 박 당선인은 창원에서 김 후보를 3만 표 가까운 차이로 이겼다.)

A local political insider analyzed, "This election saw a strong focus on the individual candidates, transcending party lines." Candidate Park consistently conveyed the message that he would dedicate himself to the development of South Gyeongsang Province by emphasizing the stability and continuity of his administration. (지역 정가 관계자는 “이번 선거는 정당을 넘어 인물론이 강하게 작용했다”고 분석했다. 박 당선인은 도정 안정성과 연속성을 앞세워 경남 발전에 전념하겠다는 메시지를 꾸준히 전달했다.)

Born in Tongyeong, candidate Park is a career bureaucrat who passed the 23rd Higher Civil Service Examination. His career includes serving as the 3rd and 4th popular election mayor of Changwon, the first mayor of Unified Changwon, president of Incheon International Airport Corporation, and a 20th and 21st-term National Assembly member. (통영 출신인 박 당선인은 제23회 행정고시에 합격한 정통 관료 출신이다. 민선 3·4기 창원시장과 초대 통합창원시장, 인천국제공항공사 사장, 제20·21대 국회의원 등을 지냈다.)

item.title: Lee Dong-seok of People Power Party Breaks through Democratic Party Stronghold… Sets Record as North Chungcheong’s Youngest Mayor (민주당 강세 뚫은 국민의힘 이동석…충북 최연소 시장 기록 썼다)
item.description:
Lee Dong-seok of People Power Party Breaks through Democratic Party Stronghold… Sets Record as North Chungcheong’s Youngest Mayor (민주당 강세 뚫은 국민의힘 이동석…충북 최연소 시장 기록 썼다)

“By just 124 votes.” (“단 124표.”)

In the 9th Local Elections held on the 3rd, candidate Lee Dong-seok (age 40) of the People Power Party was elected as the mayor of Chungju City. (지난 3일 치러진 제9회 전국동시지방선거 충주시장 선거에서 국민의힘 이동석(40) 후보가 당선됐다.)

The outcome of the Chungju mayoral election remained uncertain until the very end. Mayor-elect Lee Dong-seok garnered 52,962 votes (50.05%), defeating Democratic Party candidate Maeng Jeong-seop, who received 52,838 votes (49.94%), by a margin of 124 votes. The difference in vote share was merely 0.11 percentage points. (충주시장 선거 승부는 마지막까지 안갯속이었다. 이동석 당선인은 5만2962표(50.05%)를 얻어 5만2838표(49.94%)를 얻은 더불어민주당 맹정섭 후보를 124표 차로 꺾었다. 득표율 차이는 0.11%포인트에 불과했다.)

This election was one of the most fiercely contested battles in North Chungcheong Province and across the nation. From the early stages of vote counting, Maeng Jeong-seop maintained the lead, but around 4 a.m. on the 4th, Lee Dong-seok managed to overtake him. (이번 선거는 충북은 물론 전국에서도 손꼽히는 초접전 승부였다. 개표 초반부터 맹정섭 후보가 우위를 이어갔지만,4일 새벽 4시쯤 이동석 후보가 역전에 성공했다.)

What made it even more dramatic was the pre-election landscape. Various opinion polls had shown Maeng leading with a margin outside the margin of error. However, once the ballot boxes were opened, the results turned out differently. Despite the Democratic Party’s strong momentum, the voters of Chungju ultimately chose Lee of the People Power Party. (더욱 극적인 것은 선거 전 판세였다. 각종 여론조사에서 맹 후보가 오차범위 밖 우세를 보이며 앞서는 것으로 나타났었다. 하지만 투표함을 열자 결과는 달라졌다. 민주당 강세 흐름 속에서도 충주 유권자들은 결국 국민의힘 이 후보를 선택했다.)

This election was held to select a new mayor for the first time in 12 years due to term limits preventing incumbent Mayor Jo Gil-hyeong from seeking a third consecutive term. While the Democratic Party showed strength in most areas of North Chungcheong Province, Chungju remained a fiercely contested region that the People Power Party managed to hold onto. (이번 선거는 조길형 시장의 3선 연임 제한으로 12년 만에 새 시장을 선출하는 선거였다. 충북 대부분 지역에서 민주당이 강세를 보인 가운데 충주는 국민의힘이 지켜낸 격전지로 남게 됐다.)

Born in 1985, Mayor-elect Lee Dong-seok attended Chungju’s Gyohyeon Elementary School and Chungil Middle School before majoring in Political Science at the University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) in the United States and pursuing graduate studies in International Politics at New York University. After working as an MBN reporter, he served as a presidential secretary at the Blue House and as a policy adviser to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, gaining experience in central politics and administration. (1985년생인 이동석 당선인은 충주 교현초와 충일중을 졸업한 뒤 미국 캘리포니아대 산타바버라(UCSB)에서 정치학을 전공하고, 뉴욕대 대학원에서 국제정치학을 공부했다. MBN 기자를 거쳐 청와대 행정관과 해양수산부 장관 정책보좌관 등을 지내며 중앙 정치와 행정 경험을 쌓았다.)

A virtual political newcomer, he emphasized generational change during the election campaign, championing the slogan "A Young Chungju, A New Chungju." He proposed key pledges such as establishing the Chungju Tourism Corporation, attracting semiconductor and high-tech industries, and developing the region as a medical hub for the central area. He promised to create a city that draws young populations by expanding youth jobs and improving living conditions. (정치 신인에 가까운 그는 선거 과정에서 ‘젊은 충주, 새로운 충주’를 내세우며 세대 교체를 강조했다. 충주관광공사 설립과 반도체·첨단 산업 유치, 중부권 의료 거점 육성 등을 핵심 공약으로 제시했다. 청년 일자리 확대와 정주 여건 개선을 통해 젊은 인구가 모이는 도시를 만들겠다고 약속했다.)

Additionally, leveraging his experience working at the Blue House and central government agencies, he highlighted himself as a candidate with strengths in securing national funding and attracting businesses to sway voter sentiment. (또 청와대와 중앙부처 근무 경험을 바탕으로 국비 확보와 기업 유치에 강점을 가진 후보임을 부각하며 유권자 표심을 공략했다.)

Mayor-elect Lee Dong-seok also set a new record in North Chungcheong’s local governance history. At the age of 40, he was elected mayor of Chungju, becoming the youngest head of a local government in the province's history. The previous record was held by current lawmaker Eom Tae-yeong, who was 44 when elected mayor of Jecheon in the 3rd Local Elections in 2002. (이동석 당선인은 충북 지방자치 역사에 새로운 기록도 썼다. 만 40세 나이로 충주시장에 당선돼 충북의 역대 최연소 기초자치단체장이 됐다. 종전 기록은 2002년 제3회 지방선거에서 44세에 제천시장에 당선된 엄태영 현 국회의원이 보유하고 있었다.)

Political circles view this outcome as a reflection of local public sentiment calling for generational change. Analysts suggest that despite the Democratic Party’s strong performance, voters chose change and new leadership. (정치권에서는 이번 결과를 세대 교체를 바라는 지역 민심이 반영된 것으로 보고 있다. 민주당 강세 속에서도 유권자들이 변화와 새로운 리더십을 선택한 것이라는 분석이다.)

Mayor-elect Lee stated, "This is not my personal victory but the choice of citizens who desire change for Chungju," adding, "I accept this moment with a heavy sense of responsibility." (이 당선인은 “저 개인의 승리가 아니라 충주의 변화를 바라는 시민 여러분의 선택”이라며 “무거운 책임감으로 이 순간을 받아들인다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "I will create a city administration that prioritizes the lives of citizens, one that proves itself by fulfilling promises and moves with youthful and clean energy," and added, "Immediately after taking office, I will activate a Chungju Future Strategy Task Force to personally oversee issues such as medical service gaps, corporate attraction, regulations and permits, downtown regeneration, and improving living conditions in Seochungju." (이어 “시민의 삶을 먼저 살피는 시정, 약속을 실행해 증명하는 시정, 젊고 깨끗한 에너지로 움직이는 시정을 만들겠다”며 “취임 즉시 충주 미래전략 TF를 가동해 의료 공백과 기업 유치, 규제·인허가, 원도심 재생, 서충주 정주여건 개선 등 여러과제를 직접 챙기겠다”고 말했다.)

Mayor-elect Lee said, "Starting from worries about hospitals, jobs, children, and the elderly, I will begin with changing the daily lives of citizens," as he concluded. (이 당선인은 “병원 걱정, 일자리 걱정, 아이들 걱정, 어르신들의 걱정까지 시민의 하루를 바꾸는 일부터 시작하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: "Surge in Voter Numbers Causes Ballot Shortage"... Incheon Election Commission Apologizes for Voting Disruption (“투표자수 급증해 투표용지 부족”…인천선관위, 투표 차질 사과)
item.description:
"Surge in Voter Numbers Causes Ballot Shortage"... Incheon Election Commission Apologizes for Voting Disruption (“투표자수 급증해 투표용지 부족”…인천선관위, 투표 차질 사과)

The Incheon Metropolitan Election Commission has apologized for the ballot shortage that occurred in the Incheon region during the June 3 local elections. (인천시선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거 과정에서 발생한 인천 지역 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 사과했다.)

On the 4th, the Incheon Metropolitan Election Commission issued a press release stating, "We apologize for the situation where ballots became insufficient at some polling stations in Incheon on election day." (인천시선관위는 4일 보도자료를 내어 “선거일 (인천) 일부 투표소의 투표용지가 부족하게 된 상황에 대해 사과드린다”고 했다.)

The day before, around 5:33 p.m., voting was suspended at the 1st polling station in Songdo 5-dong, Yeonsu-gu, due to a shortage of ballots. (전날 오후 5시 33분쯤 연수구 송도5동 제1투표소에서 투표용지가 부족해 투표가 중단되는 일이 발생했다.)

Additional ballots were supplied about 15 minutes later from the Yeonsu-gu Election Commission and were distributed to around 70 waiting voters starting at approximately 5:56 p.m., delaying voting by about 20 minutes. Voting at this polling station concluded at 6:10 p.m. (추가 투표용지는 15분쯤 뒤에야 연수구선거관리위원회에서 공급됐고, 오후 5시 56분쯤부터 기다리던 유권자 70여 명에게 배부됐다. 20여 분간 투표가 지연된 것이다. 이 투표소의 투표는 오후 6시 10분에 마무리됐다.)

At the 6th polling station in Dongchun 1-dong, Yeonsu-gu, ballots were also exhausted around 5:15 p.m., and voting resumed around 5:30 p.m., about 10 minutes later. Around 70 voters completed their voting by approximately 6:25 p.m. (연수구 동춘1동 제6투표소에서도 오후 5시 15분쯤 투표용지가 소진됐고, 10여 분 뒤인 오후 5시 30분쯤부터 재개됐다. 유권자 70여 명은 오후 6시 25분쯤 투표를 모두 마쳤다.)

The Incheon Metropolitan Election Commission explained, "We assumed a voter turnout of 70%, deducted an expected advance voting rate of 20%, and calculated the remaining 50% to prepare the ballots. The number of voters on election day surged relatively at those polling stations, leading to a shortage of ballots." (인천시선관위는 “투표율을 70%로 가정하고, 예상 사전 투표율 20%를 뺀 나머지 50%를 산정해 투표용지를 준비했다”며 “해당 투표소에 상대적으로 선거일 투표자 수가 급증해 투표용지가 부족해졌다”고 했다.)

According to the National Election Commission, the voter turnout for this local election in Yeonsu-gu, Incheon, was 62.9%, an increase of 11.2 percentage points from the 51.7% turnout in 2022. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면 이번 지방선거 인천 연수구 투표율은 62.9%로, 지난 2022년 투표율 51.7%보다 11.2%포인트 상승했다.)

The Incheon Metropolitan Election Commission stated, "We are grateful to the voters who waited for 10 to 20 minutes without leaving and participated in the voting. We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused to citizens who visited the polling stations to exercise their precious voting rights." (인천시선관위 측은 “10~20여 분 대기하는 상황에서도 돌아가지 않고 투표에 참여해주신 유권자 여러분께 감사드린다”며 “소중한 주권 행사를 위해 투표소를 찾은 시민들에게 불편을 드린 점에 대해 깊이 사과드린다”고 했다.)

item.title: Independent Cho Gyu-il... Becomes Jinju's 'First Three-Term Mayor' (무소속 조규일...진주서 ‘첫 3선 시장’ 됐다)
item.description:
Independent Cho Gyu-il... Becomes Jinju's 'First Three-Term Mayor' (무소속 조규일...진주서 ‘첫 3선 시장’ 됐다 )

In the June 3 election for mayor of Jinju, South Gyeongsang Province, incumbent Cho Gyu-il (62), who left the People Power Party (PPP) and ran as an independent, successfully secured a third term. This marks the first time Jinju has produced a three-term mayor. (6·3 경남 진주시장 선거에서는 국민의힘을 탈당하고 무소속으로 출마한 조규일(62) 시장이 3선에 성공했다. 진주에서 3선 시장이 나온 것은 처음이다.)

Mayor-elect Cho won with 43.67% of the vote, defeating candidates Gal Sang-don of the Democratic Party of Korea (33.35%) and Han Gyeong-ho of the People Power Party (22.97%). (조 당선인은 이번 선거에서 43.67% 득표율로, 더불어민주당 갈상돈(33.35%), 국민의힘 한경호(22.97%) 후보를 제치고 당선됐다.)

Initially considered a strong PPP candidate for Jinju mayor, he stumbled early in the election. The PPP's South Gyeongsang Provincial Party excluded Mayor-elect Cho from the primary for the Jinju mayoral nomination. Consequently, he left the party and declared his independent candidacy. This turned the Jinju mayoral election into a three-way race between two conservative candidates and one from the Democratic Party. (당초 유력한 국민의힘 진주시장 후보로 평가받다가 선거 초반 삐끗했다. 국민의힘 경남도당이 진주시장 후보 공천에서 조 당선인을 경선 배제했다. 이에 탈당 후 무소속 출마를 선언했다. 이 때문에 진주시장 선거는 보수 진영 후보 둘과 민주당 후보 간 3파전 구도가 됐다.)

Jinju, with a population of approximately 335,000, is the central city of western South Gyeongsang. In all previous mayoral elections, candidates affiliated with the PPP (or its conservative predecessors) have won the post. No Democratic Party or independent candidate had ever been elected. Amid a split in conservative votes, it was a challenging electoral landscape for Mayor Cho, who lacked party brand advantages. (인구 33만5000여 명의 진주는 경남 서부 지역의 중심 도시로, 역대 시장 선거에서 전부 국민의힘 계열 후보가 시장직을 차지했다. 민주당은 물론 무소속 후보가 당선된 적이 없는 곳이다. 보수 표 분열 속에 정당 프리미엄이 없는 조 시장에게는 어려운 선거 구도였다.)

However, Mayor-elect Cho compensated for this by leveraging his eight years of administrative experience and high name recognition. Jinju citizens chose him over party labels, prioritizing his proven record and expertise. (하지만 조 당선인은 8년간 이어온 행정 경험과 높은 인지도를 바탕으로 이를 만회했다. 진주 시민들이 정당 간판보다 검증된 인물과 경력을 앞세운 그의 손을 들어준 것이다.)

Mayor-elect Cho stated, "The citizens protected me, even without a party affiliation. I will dedicate myself completely so that Jinju can make a greater leap forward over the next four years." (조 당선인은 “정당 울타리가 없는 저를 시민들이 지켜줬다”며 “앞으로 4년, 진주가 더 큰 도약을 할 수 있게 혼신의 힘을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

A native of Jinju, Mayor-elect Cho graduated from Daea High School and Seoul National University's Graduate School of Public Administration. He began his public service career in 1995 after passing the Local Administrative Examination. He served as Director of the Local Tax Policy Division at the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and as Vice Governor of Western South Gyeongsang Province. He was first elected in the 2018 local elections, becoming mayor of Jinju. (조 당선인은 진주 출신으로 대아고와 서울대 행정대학원을 졸업했다. 1995년 지방행정고시로 공직 생활을 시작했다. 행정안전부 지방세정책과장, 경남도 서부부지사 등을 지냈다. 2018년 지방선거에서 당선돼 진주시장이 됐다.)

item.title: "A Four-Year Term Where Residents Can Feel the Development"... Kim Jae-wook, Chilgok County Governor, Wins Re-election (“군민이 발전 체감하는 4년 될 것”...김재욱 칠곡군수, 재선 성공)
item.description:
"A Four-Year Term Where Residents Can Feel the Development"... Kim Jae-wook, Chilgok County Governor, Wins Re-election (“군민이 발전 체감하는 4년 될 것”...김재욱 칠곡군수, 재선 성공)

In the June 3rd election for the governor of Chilgok County, North Gyeongsang Province, incumbent governor Kim Jae-wook, running as the People Power Party candidate, succeeded in his re-election bid. (6·3 경북 칠곡군수 선거에서 국민의힘 후보로 나선 김재욱 현 군수가 재선에 성공했다.)

According to the National Election Commission's election statistics system on the 4th, Governor-elect Kim won with a 67.48% vote share, defeating Democratic Party candidate Kim Si-hwan, who received a 32.51% vote share. Governor-elect Kim garnered 31,930 votes, while candidate Kim received 15,381 votes. (4일 중앙선거관리위원회 선거통계시스템에 따르면, 김 당선인은 67.48% 득표율로 32.51% 득표율을 기록한 더불어민주당 김시환 후보를 제치고 당선됐다. 김 당선인은 3만1930표를, 김 후보는 1만5381표를 득표했다.)

A native of Chilgok, North Gyeongsang Province, Governor-elect Kim graduated from Seoul National University with a degree in International Economics and served as a managing director at Daegu Broadcasting Corporation (TBC). He was first elected as Chilgok County Governor in the 2022 local elections, and this time, he has become a two-term county governor. (경북 칠곡 출신인 김 당선인은 서울대 국제경제학과를 졸업하고 대구방송(TBC) 상무이사를 지냈다. 2022년 지방선거를 통해 칠곡군수에 처음 당선됐고, 이번에 재선 군수가 됐다.)

His key pledges include commencing the Baksam Oepyeong Industrial Complex construction and attracting businesses, creating jobs, improving residential conditions, and expanding the daily living population. He has stated that he will continue to push forward various pending projects, such as the construction of the Seokjeok High-Pass IC (Interchange). (주요 공약은 북삼 오평산업단지 착공 및 기업 유치, 일자리 창출, 정주 여건 개선, 생활 인구 확대 등이다. 석적 하이패스 IC 건설 등 여러 현안 사업을 지속 추진하겠다는 입장이다.)

Governor-elect Kim said, "I will accept the election results as a stern command from the residents not to stop the change and development of Chilgok." He added, "If the past four years were a time to resolve Chilgok's long-cherished projects and lay the foundation for development, the next four years will be a time to create results where residents can feel the change." (김 당선인은 “선거 결과를 칠곡의 변화와 발전을 멈추지 말라는 군민 여러분의 준엄한 명령으로 받아들이겠다”며 “지난 4년이 칠곡의 숙원 사업을 해결하고 발전의 기반을 다지는 시간이었다면 향후 4년은 군민들이 변화를 느낄 수 있는 성과를 만드는 시간이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Independent Oh Tae-wan, Uiryeong County Mayor Who Left People Power Party, Succeeds in Third Term (‘국힘 탈당’ 무소속 오태완 의령군수, 3선 성공)
item.description:
Independent Oh Tae-wan, Uiryeong County Mayor Who Left People Power Party, Succeeds in Third Term (‘국힘 탈당’ 무소속 오태완 의령군수, 3선 성공 )

In the June 3 by-election for Uiryeong County Mayor in South Gyeongsang Province, incumbent Oh Tae-wan, running as an independent, defeated candidates from both ruling and opposition parties to secure his third term. (6·3 경남 의령군수 선거에서 무소속으로 출마한 현직 오태완 군수가 여야 후보를 제치고 3선에 성공했다.)

Oh secured 46.81% of the vote, beating Son Tae-young of the Democratic Party of Korea (27.44%) and Kang Won-deok of the People Power Party (25.73%), confirming his election. (오 군수는 46.81% 득표율로, 더불어민주당 손태영(27.44%), 국민의힘 강원덕(25.73%) 후보를 제치고 당선을 확정했다.)

Oh, a two-term county mayor, was first elected in the 2021 by-election and won again in the 2022 local elections. (오 군수는 2021년 재·보궐선거와 2022년 지방선거에서 의령군수로 당선된 재선 군수다.)

During his tenure, he faced several criminal trials on charges such as sexual assault, but avoided a conviction that would invalidate his election, thereby retaining his position. (임기 중 강제추행 등의 혐의로 여러 형사 재판을 받아왔는데, 당선 무효형을 받지 않아 군수직을 유지했다.)

In this local election, he initially applied for nomination under the People Power Party, but due to opposition from other applicants, he left the party and declared his candidacy as an independent. (이번 지방선거에서 국민의힘 소속으로 공천을 신청했지만, 공천 신청자들의 반발로 탈당 후 무소속 출마를 선언했다.)

Despite competing in a three-way race against ruling and opposition party candidates without party backing, his campaign strategy of leveraging his image as a "mayor who gets things done," based on achievements during his previous term, is considered the key factor in his victory. (정당 프리미엄 없이 여야 후보와 3파전을 벌였지만, 지난 임기 동안 이뤄낸 성과를 앞세워 ‘일 잘하는 군수’ 이미지를 앞세운 선거 전략이 당선의 요인으로 꼽힌다.)

During his term, Oh achieved results such as securing the expansion of National Route 20 to four lanes, holding a memorial service for the Woo Sun-kyung shooting incident and establishing a memorial park, opening the Gyeongnam Future Education Center, hosting the Rich Rich Festival, and introducing Gyeongnam's first fully public bus system. (오 군수는 임기 중 국도 20호선 4차로 확장 결정, 우순경 총기사건 위령제 개최 및 추모 공원 설립, 경남 미래 교육원 개관, 리치리치 페스티벌 개최, 경남 첫 버스 완전 공영제 도입 등의 성과를 냈다.)

Oh stated, "This victory is the result of the fervent hopes of the county residents that 'Uiryeong must not stop here but continue to develop.' The next four years will be a crucial golden time that determines Uiryeong's future for the next 100 years. I will push for extending the South-North Axis 6 expressway and establishing a new Uiryeong IC, and revitalize the local economy to make Uiryeong a place where young people come." (오 군수는 “이번 승리는 ‘의령이 여기서 멈추면 안 되고 계속 발전해야 한다’는 군민들의 간절한 염원이 모인 결과”라며 “앞으로 4년은 의령의 미래 100년을 결정짓는 중요한 골든타임이다. 남북 6축 고속도로 연장과 의령 IC 신설을 추진하고, 지역 경제를 살려 젊은이들이 찾는 의령을 만들겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party's Lee Min-keun Becomes 'First Re-elected Mayor' in Ansan, a Democratic Party Stronghold (국민의힘 이민근, 민주당 우세 안산서 ‘최초 연임 시장’ 됐다)
item.description:
People Power Party's Lee Min-keun Becomes 'First Re-elected Mayor' in Ansan, a Democratic Party Stronghold (국민의힘 이민근, 민주당 우세 안산서 ‘최초 연임 시장’ 됐다)

In the June 3 local election for the mayor of Ansan, Gyeonggi Province, People Power Party candidate Lee Min-keun was elected. This marks the first time a sitting mayor of Ansan has successfully won re-election in the city's history. (6·3 지방선거 경기 안산시장 선거에서 국민의힘 이민근 후보가 당선됐다. 현직 안산시장이 재선에 성공한 것은 안산시정 사상 처음이다.)

According to the final vote count from the National Election Commission on the 4th, Lee secured 50.44% (150,393 votes), defeating Democratic Party candidate Chun Young-mi, who garnered 49.55% (147,762 votes). (4일 중앙선거관리위원회 최종 개표 결과에 따르면 이 후보는 50.44%(15만393표)의 득표율을 얻으며 49.55%(14만7762표)의 득표율을 기록한 더불어민주당 천영미 후보를 제치고 당선됐다.)

Around 8 p.m. on the 3rd, Chun initially led in the early vote counting. However, from around 1 a.m. on the 4th, Lee-elect narrowed the gap, trailing by about 1 percentage point. By around 6 a.m., Lee-elect secured victory with a margin of 2,631 votes. (3일 오후 8시쯤 개표 초반에는 천 후보가 앞섰다. 그러나 4일 오전 1시쯤부터 이민근 당선인이 1%포인트 안팎의 격차를 보이며 바짝 따라붙었다. 이어 6시쯤 2631표 차이를 보이며 이 당선인이 당선을 확정지었다.)

Previously, no sitting mayor in Ansan had succeeded in winning a second term. Lee-elect becomes the first to achieve re-election as mayor. (그동안 안산에서는 현직 시장이 재선에 성공한 사례가 없었다. 이 당선인이 최초로 연임 시장이 됐다.)

Lee-elect stated, "I will be a mayor of unity," adding, "I will not be distracted by superficial politics, but will repay you with actions that change citizens' lives and with substantial results." (이 당선인은 “통합의 시장이 되겠다”며 “보여주기식 정치에 한눈팔지 않고, 오직 시민의 삶을 바꾸는 실천과 묵직한 결과물로 보답하겠다”고 했다.)

In light of this election outcome, locals are calling it an upset. Ansan has been considered a stronghold for the Democratic Party, with its candidates winning the mayoral election three consecutive times since 2010. In the concurrent by-election for the Ansan Gap district, Democratic Party candidate Kim Nam-guk was also elected. (이번 선거 결과를 두고 지역에서는 이변이라는 말이 나온다. 안산은 2010년 시장 선거부터 더불어민주당 계열 후보가 내리 3번 승리해 민주당 지지세가 강한 곳이라고 평가받았다. 이번 선거와 함께 치러진 안산 갑 재선거에서도 더불어민주당 김남국 후보가 당선됐다.)

Lee-elect previously won the 2022 local election by a narrow margin of 178 votes. At that time, the Democratic Party's incumbent mayor was eliminated during the nomination process, leading to a split in votes when a candidate ran as an independent, which allowed Lee-elect to secure victory. (이 당선인은 2022년 지방선거 때 178표 차이로 신승을 거뒀다. 당시 민주당 현역 시장이 공천에서 탈락하자, 무소속으로 출마해 표가 갈리면서 이 당선인이 승리할 수 있었다.)

Meanwhile, Chun candidate, who aimed to become the 'first female mayor of Ansan,' was defeated. During the party primary process, Chun faced controversy when a video surfaced on social media in which she explained her past drunk driving offense, saying, "I have one drunk driving offense. President Lee Jae-myung also has a criminal record. Didn't you vote for President Lee Jae-myung?" (한편, 천 후보는 ‘최초 여성 안산시장’에 도전했지만 패했다. 천 후보는 당내 경선 과정 중 자신의 음주 운전 전과를 설명하는 과정에서 “저 음주 전과 한 번 있다. 이재명 대통령도 전과가 있다. 이재명 대통령 안 찍었느냐”고 말하는 영상이 소셜미디어를 통해 퍼지면서 논란이 되기도 했다.)

item.title: Jung Dong-young, Visiting Mongolia, Refers to North Korea as ‘DPRK’ in English Speech (몽골 방문중인 정동영 영어연설에서 北 ‘DPRK’로 호칭)
item.description:
Jung Dong-young, Visiting Mongolia, Refers to North Korea as ‘DPRK’ in English Speech (몽골 방문중인 정동영 영어연설에서 北 ‘DPRK’로 호칭)

Jung Dong-young, Minister of Unification, currently visiting Mongolia, said on the 4th, “We can start four-party talks among the Republic of Korea, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (North Korea), the United States, and China.” In his English speech that day, Minister Jung referred to North Korea four times not as ‘North Korea’ but by its official English name, ‘Democratic People’s Republic of Korea’ and its abbreviation ‘DPRK.’ (몽골을 방문중인 정동영 통일부 장관은 4일 “우리는 대한민국, 조선민주주의인민공화국(북한), 미국, 중국 간 4자 대화를 시작할 수 있다”고 했다. 정 장관은 영어로 한 이날 연설에서 북한을 ‘North Korea’ 대신 네 차례에 걸쳐 영문 공식 국호인 ‘Democratic People’s Republic of Korea’와 이를 축약한 ‘DPRK’로 불렀다.)

In a special address at the 11th Ulaanbaatar Northeast Asian Security Dialogue (Ulaanbaatar Dialogue) opening in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, Minister Jung stated, “To sustain peace, we must end the armistice regime and establish a ‘peace regime on the Korean Peninsula,’” highlighting the need for four-party talks to achieve this. (정 장관은 이날 몽골 울란바타르에서 개막한 제11차 울란바타르 동북아 안보 대화(울란바타르 대화) 특별연설에서 “(한반도) 평화를 지속시키기 위해 우리는 정전체제를 종식하고 ‘한반도 평화체제’를 구축해야 한다”며 이를 위한 4자 대화 필요성을 언급했다.)

Minister Jung said, “We should gradually expand this framework (the four-party talks) to include other Northeast Asian countries such as Mongolia, Japan, and Russia,” adding, “If these three axes—restoring inter-Korean trust, institutionalizing a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula, and advancing multilateral dialogue in Northeast Asia—move forward in unison, we can build a new peace order across the entire Northeast Asian region.” He further noted, “The journey toward a peace order can bring about shared growth in Northeast Asia.” (정 장관은 “점차 이 틀(4자 대화)을 확대해 몽골, 일본, 러시아를 포함한 다른 동북아시아 국가들도 함께하도록 해야 할 것”이라며 “남북 간 신뢰 복원, 한반도 평화체제 제도화, 동북아 다자 대화 진전, 이 세 축이 일제히 앞으로 나아간다면 우리는 동북아 전역에 새로운 평화질서를 구축할 수 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “평화질서를 향한 여정은 동북아의 공동성장을 가져올 수 있다”고 했다.)

Minister Jung also mentioned the Greater Tumen Initiative (GTI) on this day, outlining a plan to promote cooperation on the Arctic shipping route in connection with it, as well as linking the Seoul-Beijing high-speed railway. He explained, “If the GTI member countries work together, we could connect regional rail networks such as the Trans-Siberian Railway (TSR), the Trans-China Railway (TCR), the Trans-Mongolian Railway (TMGR), and the Seoul-Beijing high-speed railway with the Arctic shipping route,” introducing the possibility of building an innovative logistics network across Eurasia. (정 장관을 이날 ‘광역두만개발계획(GTI)’을 언급하면서 이와 연계한 북극 항로 협력 및 서울~베이징 고속철도 연결을 추진하는 구상을 설명했다. 정 장관은 “GTI 회원국들이 함께 노력한다면, 우리는 시베리아횡단철도(TSR), 중국횡단철도(TCR), 몽골횡단철도(TMGR), 그리고 서울~베이징 고속철도와 같은 지역 철도망을 북극 항로와 연결할 수 있을 것”이라며 유라시아 전역에 혁신적인 물류 네트워크를 구축할 수 있게 된다고 소개했다.)

Minister Jung urged North Korea, saying, “To turn these visions into reality, I call on the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea to rejoin the GTI as a full member,” adding, “The success of this initiative depends on the re-engagement of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and they will be the greatest beneficiaries of this initiative.” (정 장관을 북한을 향해 “이러한 구상들을 현실로 바꾸기 위해 조선민주주의인민공화국이 정회원으로서 GTI에 재가입할 것을 촉구한다”며 “이 구상의 성공은 조선민주주주의인민공화국의 재참여에 달려 있으며, 그들은 이 구상의 가장 큰 수혜자가 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, a Unification Ministry official stated regarding the designation for North Korea, “At international conferences, including on the UN stage, our government delegation has also referred to the North by its official name, DPRK, on several occasions.” The Unification Ministry explained that this marks the first time a Minister of Unification has visited Mongolia and participated in the ‘Ulaanbaatar Dialogue,’ a 1.5-track dialogue event, following a request from the Mongolian government. (앞서 통일부 당국자는 북한의 호칭에 대해 “유엔 무대를 포함한 국제회의에서 우리 정부대표단도 북한의 호칭을 공식 국호 DPRK로 여러 차례 지칭했다”고 했다. 통일부 장관의 몽골 방문 및 1.5트랙 대화인 ‘울란바타르 대화’ 행사 참석은 이번이 처음으로, 몽골 정부의 요청에 따른 것이라고 통일부는 설명했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon on Possibility of Rejoining People Power Party: “I Will Surely Return... This Victory Is Part of That Process” (한동훈, 국힘 복당 가능성에 “반드시 돌아간다... 이번 승리도 그 과정”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon on Possibility of Rejoining People Power Party: “I Will Surely Return... This Victory Is Part of That Process” (한동훈, 국힘 복당 가능성에 “반드시 돌아간다... 이번 승리도 그 과정”)

Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who won the by-election for the Busan North Gap National Assembly seat, said on the 4th regarding the possibility of rejoining the People Power Party (PPP): “I said on the day I was unjustly expelled from the PPP that I would surely return. This election victory is part of fulfilling that promise.” Previously, after being expelled by the PPP's Jang Dong-hyuk leadership in January over the ‘party member bulletin board incident,’ the then-lawmaker-elect Han had held a press conference and stated, “Please wait. I will definitely come back.” (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 당선된 무소속 한동훈 후보는 4일 국민의힘 복당 가능성에 대해 “제가 (국민의힘에서) 부당하게 제명된 날 반드시 돌아간다는 말씀을 드렸다. 이번 선거 승리도 그 약속을 실천하는 과정”이라고 했다. 앞서 한동훈 당선인은 지난 1월 ‘당원 게시판 사건’과 관련해 국민의힘 장동혁 지도부에 의해 제명당하자 기자회견을 열고 “기다려 달라. 저는 반드시 돌아올 것”이라고 했었다.)

In a press conference held that afternoon at the election office in Buk-gu, Busan, Han responded to a reporter’s question about whether he planned to return to the PPP after his election, saying, “Based on the public sentiment in this election, conservative reconstruction will take place.” He added, “Many PPP lawmakers clearly see the need for conservative reconstruction, and I feel that many of them sympathize with the cause and principles of conservative reconstruction I have proposed.” (한동훈 당선인은 이날 오후 부산 북구 선거사무소에서 열린 기자회견에서 ‘당선 이후 국민의힘으로 돌아갈 계획이 있느냐’는 기자 질문에 “이번 선거 민심을 바탕으로 보수 재건이 될 것”이라면서 이같이 답했다. 한 당선인은 “국민의힘 다수 의원들도 보수 재건 방향은 분명히 필요하고, 그 과정에서 제가 제시했던 보수 재건의 명분이나 대의에 공감하는 분들이 굉장히 많다고 느끼고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding his plans for parliamentary activities, Han said, “I stated that my victory would be a clear warning against the Democratic Party’s push for ‘withdrawal of indictment’ (special counsel). I think I will need to start my role by blocking that.” He added, “The Lee Jae-myung administration must not misjudge the public will clearly expressed in this election.” (한 당선인은 의정 활동 계획에 대해 “제 승리가 (민주당에서 추진하는) ‘공소 취소’(특검)에 대한 명백한 경고가 될 것이라는 말씀을 드렸다. 그 점을 저지하는 것에서 제 역할을 시작해야 할 것 같다”며 “이재명 정권은 이번 선거에서 분명히 드러난 민의를 오판하지 말아야 한다”고 했다.)

Han also criticized PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, saying, “The words and actions of those who appear to represent the PPP now, like the party power faction, do not match the dignity or competence that a conservative party should have.” He continued, “It is time for them to reflect and set the right direction. I hope we can rebuild conservatism through a shared consensus on why we engage in politics. That is the spirit of the times revealed through this election.” (또한 한 당선인은 장동혁 대표를 향해 “지금 국민의힘을 마치 대표하는 것처럼 보이는 당권파의 언행들은 보수 정당이 가져온 품격이나 실력에 맞지 않는다”면서 “이제는 반성하고 방향을 제대로 잡아야 한다”고 했다. 이어 “왜 정치를 하는 지에 대한 공감대를 통해 보수를 재건할 수 있으면 좋겠다. 그것이 지금 이 선거를 통해 드러난 시대 정신”이라고 말했다.)

On the election results, Han said, “The people are incredibly wise and great. While not completely abandoning the conservative party, in places where meaningful victories occurred, they granted unexpected wins to those who resonate with the direction of conservative reconstruction.” He added, “This carries the people’s command to overcome the anxiety of conservatism’s regression and rebuild conservatism.” He also noted, “They also delivered a meaningful warning to the Lee Jae-myung Democratic Party administration.” (한 당선인은 이번 선거 결과에 대해 “국민들께서 대단히 현명하고 위대하다”면서 “보수 정당을 완전히 버리지도 않으면서, 보수 정당의 의미 있는 승리가 난 곳을 보면 보수 재건의 방향성에 공감하는 분에게 의외의 승리를 안겨준 것”이라고 했다. 이어 한 당선인은 “보수가 퇴행하는 걱정을 극복해내고 보수를 재건하라는 국민의 명령이 담겨 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이재명 민주당 정권에 대해서도 의미 있는 경고를 해주셨다”고 했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk Steps Down as Party Leader, Taking Responsibility for Defeat in Pyeongtaek-eul: "Will Reflect and Prepare for Next Steps" (조국, 평택을 패배 책임지고 당대표직 사퇴 “성찰하면서 다음 준비”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk Steps Down as Party Leader, Taking Responsibility for Defeat in Pyeongtaek-eul: "Will Reflect and Prepare for Next Steps" (조국, 평택을 패배 책임지고 당대표직 사퇴 “성찰하면서 다음 준비”)

Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, announced on the 4th, "I will take responsibility for the results of the June 3 election and step down as party leader." Cho ran in the by-election for the National Assembly in Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province, but finished in third place among five candidates, losing the election. (조국 조국혁신당 대표는 4일 “6·3 선거 결과에 책임을 지고 당대표직에서 물러나겠다”고 밝혔다. 조 대표는 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마했으나 후보 5명 중 3위로 낙선했다.)

In a statement posted on Facebook that day, Cho said, "I will pause for a moment, but I ask my party comrades to move forward confidently," making his resignation known. (조 대표는 이날 페이스북에 올린 입장문에서 “저는 잠시 멈추지만, 당원 동지들은 당당하게 직진해달라”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Cho stated, "In this election, I failed to open a new path of hope for the party comrades who devoted themselves under the name of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party. It was all because of my shortcomings." (조 대표는 “이번 선거에서 조국혁신당의 이름으로 헌신한 당원 동지들 앞에 새로운 희망의 길을 열지 못했다”며 “모두 제가 부족했던 탓”이라고 했다.)

He added, "Although the June 3 election results may lead to internal debates and divisions within the broader democratic camp, the fact that the Cho Kuk Innovation Party remains the third-largest party in the National Assembly with 12 seats, as a progressive and reformist force, does not change. I ask the new leadership to make the DNA of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party stronger and more resilient." He also urged, "Please bring a definitive end to the era's key task of prosecutorial reform." (그는 “6·3 선거 결과로 인해 범민주진영 내부 논쟁과 균열이 예상되지만, 조국혁신당이 열두 석을 가진 진보개혁적 원내 3당이라는 사실은 변하지 않는다”며 “새 지도부와 함께 조국혁신당의 DNA를 더욱 강하고 단단하게 만들어 달라”고 했다. 또 “시대적 과제인 검찰개혁에 확실한 마침표를 찍어달라”고 했다.)

Cho further said, "I too will not grow weary. There is no such thing as giving up on the entire war after losing a single battle. I will reflect on myself, temper myself, and prepare for the next steps." (조 대표는 “저 또한 지치지 않겠다. 한 번의 전투에서 졌다고 전쟁을 포기하는 법은 없다”며 “저 자신을 성찰하고 담금질하면서 다음을 준비하겠다”고 했다.)

In the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party was elected. Cho failed to unify with other opposition candidates in this election, such as Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea and Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party. In particular, Cho engaged in a fierce debate with Kim, whom he competed with for the lead, raising past remarks and various allegations. As the vote count came in, it was assessed that Yoo's victory was due to a split in the progressive vote and a consolidation of the conservative vote. (평택을 재선거에선 유의동 국민의힘 후보가 당선됐다. 조 대표는 이번 선거 때 김용남 더불어민주당 후보, 김재연 진보당 후보 등 범여권 후보들과 단일화를 이루지 못했다. 특히 조 대표는 선두를 놓고 경쟁한 김 후보를 향해 과거 발언과 각종 의혹을 제기하며 거센 공방을 벌였다. 개표 결과가 나오자 진보 진영 표 분열과 보수 결집으로 유 후보가 당선됐다는 평가가 나왔다.)

item.title: A Mere 44 Votes Determined Fate… Democratic Party’s Kang Seok-ju Recaptures Tongyeong Mayor’s Office After 4 Years (단 ‘44표’가 운명 갈랐다… 민주당 강석주, 4년 만에 통영시장 탈환)
item.description:
A Mere 44 Votes Determined Fate… Democratic Party’s Kang Seok-ju Recaptures Tongyeong Mayor’s Office After 4 Years (단 ‘44표’가 운명 갈랐다… 민주당 강석주, 4년 만에 통영시장 탈환 )

'44 votes' (‘44표’)

This margin is the smallest difference between the winner and loser among all heads of metropolitan and basic local governments in the June 3 local elections. (이번 6·3 지방선거 광역·기초자치단체장 전체를 통틀어 당선자와 낙선자 간 가장 적은 표 차다.)

The outcome of the 6·3 Gyeongnam Tongyeong mayoral election was decided by just 44 votes. Democratic Party candidate Kang Seok-ju (62) received 33,626 votes (48.97%), defeating incumbent People Power Party Mayor Cheon Yeong-ki, who garnered 33,582 votes (48.90%). The difference was 0.07 percentage points. (6·3 경남 통영시장 선거는 단 ‘44표’로 당락이 갈렸다. 더불어민주당 강석주(62) 후보는 3만3626표(득표율 48.97%)를 얻어, 3만3582표(48.90%)를 얻은 국민의힘 천영기 시장을 이겼다. 0.07%포인트 차다.)

Kang secured victory after a close battle in which the rankings changed multiple times until the final stages of vote counting. The two had also engaged in a razor-thin contest four years ago. In the 2022 local elections, then-incumbent Kang lost the mayor’s office to People Power Party candidate Cheon by a margin of 1,679 votes. In this rematch four years later, Kang succeeded in avenging his defeat, becoming a mayor with a staggered second term. (개표 막판까지 순위가 수차례 바뀌는 혼전 끝에 강 후보가 승리했다. 두 사람은 4년 전에도 초박빙 승부를 벌인 바 있다. 2022년 지방선거 당시 현직이던 강 후보는 국민의힘 천 후보에게 1679표 차로 패하며 시장직을 내줬다. 4년 만에 이뤄진 맞대결에서 설욕에 성공한 강 당선인은 징검다리 재선 시장이 됐다.)

Kang-elect expressed, “More than joy, I feel a heavy sense of responsibility,” adding, “I will deeply engrave in my heart the solemn command of the citizens contained in every single vote.” He promised to restructure the Anjeong Industrial Complex into a smart ship cluster to revitalize Tongyeong’s economy. He also pledged to introduce eco-friendly wireless trams to present a new paradigm for Tongyeong tourism. Additionally, he proposed policies such as supplying ‘100-won housing’ to reduce the housing burden on young people. (강 당선인은 “기쁨보다는 무거운 책임감이 앞선다”며 “한 표에 담긴 시민의 엄숙한 명령을 가슴 깊이 새기겠다”고 소감을 밝혔다. 그는 안정산업단지를 스마트 선박 클러스터로 재구조화해 통영 경제를 살리겠다고 공약했다. 또 친환경 무가선 트램을 설치해 통영 관광의 새로운 패러다임을 제시하겠다고 약속했다. 청년 주거 부담을 낮추는 ‘100원 주택’ 공급 등의 공약도 내놨다.)

Kang-elect, a native of Saryang-myeon in Tongyeong, completed his elementary, middle, and high school education in Tongyeong and graduated from Korea University’s Graduate School of Public Administration. He became a Gyeongnam provincial council member through a by-election in 2004 as a candidate of the Grand National Party. He was elected in the 2006 and 2010 provincial council elections, becoming a three-term councilor. Ahead of the 2017 presidential election, he joined the Democratic Party and was elected Tongyeong mayor in the 2018 local elections. This was the first time a candidate from a Democratic Party-affiliated party was elected in Tongyeong since the implementation of the local autonomy system in 1995. item.title: PPP's Jang Dong-hyuk Rejects Resignation Calls... "Disappointing Result, but a Spark of Hope Remains" (국힘 장동혁 사퇴론 일축... “아쉬운 결과지만 희망 불씨”)
item.description:
PPP's Jang Dong-hyuk Rejects Resignation Calls... "Disappointing Result, but a Spark of Hope Remains" (국힘 장동혁 사퇴론 일축... “아쉬운 결과지만 희망 불씨”)

People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 4th regarding the June 3 local elections, "While it's a disappointing election result, I will not shirk my heavy responsibilities and will find a new path forward together with party members." Although there have been calls within the PPP for the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership to resign over the election loss, Representative Jang's remarks were interpreted as dismissing such claims. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 4일 6·3 지방선거와 관련해 “아쉬운 선거 결과”라면서도 “제게 주어진 막중한 책임을 외면하지 않고 당원들과 함께 나아갈 새 길을 찾겠다”고 했다. 이번 선거 패배를 놓고 국민의힘 내부에서 장동혁 지도부 사퇴론이 나왔지만, 장 대표는 이런 일각의 주장을 일축한 것으로 해석됐다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Jang said, "I first want to offer my apologies to the citizens who supported us," adding, "I congratulate all those who were elected, and I offer my sincere condolences to the candidates who fought hard but unfortunately lost." (장 대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “지지해 주신 국민 여러분께 먼저 송구스럽다는 말씀을 드린다”면서 이같이 밝혔다. 그는 “당선되신 모든 분들 축하드린다”며 “분투하시고도 안타깝게 패배하신 후보님들 진심으로 위로의 말씀을 드린다”고 했다.)

Regarding the election outcome, Representative Jang assessed, "Although this election was difficult in every way, we have preserved a spark of hope." He continued, "This must be the people's command to stand against the arrogant and reckless Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party, to protect the people's livelihoods and defend the Republic of Korea. Citizens, please fight alongside us. Comrades and party members, do not lose your courage." (장 대표는 이번 선거 결과에 대해 “모든 상황이 어려웠던 이번 선거였지만 우리는 희망의 불씨를 지켜냈다”고 자평했다. 이어 장 대표는 “오만하고 무도한 이재명과 민주당에 맞서서 국민의 삶을 지키고 대한민국을 지키라는 국민의 명령일 것”이라며 “국민 여러분 함께 싸워 주십시오. 당원 동지 여러분 용기를 잃지 말아 주십시오”라고 했다.)

Within the party, calls for Representative Jang's accountability have emerged. PPP candidate Yoo Ui-dong, who won the by-election for the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly seat, said on SBS Radio that morning, "I believe (Representative Jang) will naturally be contemplating (his position)." (당내에선 장 대표 책임론이 나왔다. 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 당선된 국민의힘 유의동 후보는 이날 오전 SBS라디오에서 “(장 대표가) 당연히 (거취) 고민을 하실 것이라고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

PPP lawmaker Kim Yong-tae posted on Facebook, "I hope this shortage of ballot papers does not become a rotten lifeline for the party leadership to evade responsibility for the election defeat. The greater the arrogance and mismanagement of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the more clearly this local election result exposes the limits of the party leadership." (국민의힘 김용태 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “이번 투표용지 부족 사태가 당 지도부의 선거 패배 책임을 회피하는 썩은 동아줄이 되지 않기를 바란다”면서 “이재명 정권의 오만과 실정이 클수록 이번 지방선거의 결과는 당 지도부의 리더십 한계를 명확히 보여준다”고 했다.)

Another PPP lawmaker, Ahn Sang-hoon, wrote on Facebook, "The Jang Dong-hyuk leadership absurdly expelled former leader Han Dong-hoon, who then enters the National Assembly. Mayor Oh Se-hoon kept Seoul safe by keeping his distance from the leadership. Popular sentiment is divine will. The party leadership must quickly decide on its position." (국민의힘 안상훈 의원도 페이스북에서 “장동혁 지도부가 황당 제명한 한동훈 전 대표의 의회 입성. 지도부와 거리 둬서 서울 지킨 오세훈 시장”이라며 “민심은 천심. 당 지도부는 거취를 속히 정해야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Seoul Mayor, South Gyeongsang Governor, Pyeongtaek B... Exit Polls in Key Battlegrounds Way Off (서울시장·경남지사·평택을... 접전지 너무 틀린 출구조사)
item.description:
In the June 3 local elections, exit polls by three major broadcasters and pre-election opinion polls showed discrepancies from actual vote counts in some key regions, even flipping the winners. In the biggest battleground, the Seoul mayoral race, an exit poll predicted Democratic Party candidate Chung Won-oh would prevail, but the actual winner was People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon, sparking debate over survey accuracy. Analysts suggest that the record-high early voting rate of 23.51%—not captured by exit polls—and a relatively lower response rate from People Power Party supporters might have contributed to the discrepancy. <<> In a joint exit poll released by broadcasters KBS, MBC, and SBS immediately after voting ended at 6 p.m. on the 3rd, they predicted Chung Won-oh would win with 51.4% against Oh Se-hoon's 46.0%, giving Chung a 5.4 percentage point lead. <<> However, actual ballot counting showed Oh mounting a late comeback to win by a margin of 1.02 percentage points. This meant a gap of over 6 percentage points between the exit poll prediction and the actual result, and the predicted winner was wrong. <<> In the South Gyeongsang Province governor election as well, the exit poll predicted Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo with 54.3% and People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo with 45.7%. But the actual count gave Park 51.28% to Kim's 48.71%, a lead of 2.57 percentage points for Park. This resulted in an 11.17 percentage point gap between prediction and reality. <<> Some errors were also confirmed in parliamentary by-elections. In Buk-gu, Busan, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo was expected to win by a slim margin, but independent candidate Han Dong-hoon actually won. In the Pyeongtaek B by-election in Gyeonggi Province, a tight win was predicted for the Rebuilding Korea Party's Cho Kuk, but People Power Party candidate Yoo Ui-dong won. However, in a majority of metropolitan and provincial gubernatorial races, the exit poll results matched the actual winners. On the 3rd, broadcasters made statements during their election coverage such as, "Based on exit poll predictions, Democratic Party candidate Choo Mi-ae is expected to win Gyeonggi Province governor, and candidate Lee Cheol-woo is likely to win North Gyeongsang Province governor." <<> The high early voting rate is cited as a background factor for the exit poll errors. Exit polls are conducted at polling stations on election day, targeting voters who have just cast their ballots. Early voters are reflected through separate surveys and statistical adjustments. <<> The early voting rate for this local election was 23.51%, the highest ever for a local election. Some also point to the possibility that voters of a certain inclination avoided responding. In fact, after discrepancies between exit polls and actual results surfaced in last year's presidential election, some experts pointed to issues with the response rate among conservative voters. <<> Pre-election opinion polls also differed from actual results in some regions. In the Seoul mayoral race, many polls showed Chung Won-oh in the lead, while some suggested a race within the margin of error. Few polls indicated an advantage for Oh Se-hoon. <<> Polling agencies typically explain that factors like declining response rates, the expansion of early voting, and late shifts in voter sentiment can affect survey errors. <<> In this local election, while exit polls and opinion polls generally captured the overall trends, differences with actual results appeared in a few key battlegrounds—Seoul, South Gyeongsang, Buk-gu Busan, and Pyeongtaek B in Gyeonggi—likely leading to ongoing discussions about accuracy. <<> Notably, as voters were casting ballots past the official 6 p.m. closing time due to a shortage of ballot papers, the broadcasters' exit poll report declaring "Chung Won-oh in the lead" was aired, raising questions about whether it directly or indirectly influenced voters still waiting to vote. (6·3 지방선거에서 방송 3사 출구조사와 선거 전 여론조사가 일부 주요 지역에서는 실제 개표 결과와 당락도 엇갈리는 차이를 보인 것으로 나타났다. 최대 승부처인 서울시장 선거에서는 출구조사가 더불어민주당 정원오 후보의 우세를 예측했지만 실제로는 국민의힘 오세훈 후보가 승리해 조사 정확도를 놓고 뒷말이 나왔다. 출구 조사에 잡히지 않는 사전 투표의 참여율이 23.51%로 역대 최고치였던 데다가 국민의힘 지지층이 출구 조사에 상대적으로 덜 응한 것이 영향을 준 것 아니냐는 분석이 나온다.)

item.title: Park Yong-seon, a three-term Gyeongbuk provincial councilor and former POSCO employee, elected as Pohang mayor (포스코 출신 3선 경북도의원 지낸 박용선 포항시장 당선)
item.description:
Park Yong-seon, a candidate from the People Power Party who previously worked at POSCO and served as vice-chairman of the Gyeongbuk Provincial Council, has been elected mayor of Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province. The "steel city" of Pohang is the largest city in North Gyeongsang Province, with a population of 480,000 and an annual budget of approximately 3.088 trillion won. (포스코 출신으로 경북도의회 부의장을 지낸 박용선 국민의힘 후보가 경북 포항시장에 당선됐다. ‘철강 도시’ 포항은 경북에서 가장 큰 도시다. 인구 48만명에 1년 예산은 3조880억원 규모다.)

In the June 3 by-election for the mayor of Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province, Mayor-elect Park won with 49.29% of the vote, defeating Park Hee-jeong, the candidate from the Democratic Party of Korea (32.48%). Originally from Pyeongchang, Gangwon Province, Mayor-elect Park graduated from Pohang Steel High School's electrical engineering department and worked on-site at POSCO for 16 years. He later served as the spokesperson for the Saenuri Party's Gyeongbuk Provincial Party and as a three-term provincial councilor. (6·3 경북 포항시장 선거에서 박 당선인은 49.29％의 득표율로 박희정 더불어민주당 후보(32.48％)를 누르고 당선됐다. 강원 평창 출신인 박 당선인은 포항제철공고 전기과를 졸업한 뒤 포스코에서 16년간 현장직으로 일했다. 이후 새누리당 경북도당 대변인, 3선 도의원 등을 지냈다.)

Mayor-elect Park stated, "I will create a warm city, Pohang, where three to four generations can stay together without leaving, thanks to jobs and education," adding, "I will work together with Pohang citizens to build a greater Pohang and a better tomorrow." (박 당선인은 “일자리와 교육이 있어 3~4대가 떠나지 않고 함께 사는 따뜻한 도시, 포항을 만들어 내겠다”며 “더 큰 포항, 더 나은 내일을 포항 시민과 함께 만들어 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

On his first day after being elected, the 4th, Mayor-elect Park met with POSCO Group Chairman Jang In-hwa at POSCO headquarters to discuss measures for mutual cooperation, such as restoring the livelihood economy and strengthening the competitiveness of regional industries. (박 당선인은 당선 첫날인 4일 포스코 본사에서 장인화 포스코 그룹 회장을 만나 민생 경제 회복과 지역 산업 경쟁력 강화 등 상생 협력 방안을 논의했다.)

At the meeting, he exchanged opinions on the challenges facing the steel industry, which is struggling due to the global economic slowdown, changes in industrial structure, and declining steel demand. (그는 이 자리에서 글로벌 경기 둔화와 산업 구조 변화, 철강 수요 감소 등으로 어려움을 겪고 있는 철강업체 현안에 대해 의견을 나눴다.)

The steel industry holds significant weight in the local economy, with over 33,000 Pohang citizens being POSCO employees or workers at partner companies. However, the steel industry is currently facing difficulties due to the aftermath of low-cost offensives from China and U.S. tariff hikes, which have also frozen the local economy. (포항시민 중 포스코 임직원과 협력업체 직원만 해도 3만3000명이 넘을 정도로 지역 경제에서 철강 산업의 비중은 크다. 하지만 현재 철강 산업은 중국발 저가 공세와 미국의 관세 인상 등 여파로 어려움을 겪고 있으면서 지역 경제도 얼어붙어 있다.)

Mayor-elect Park stated, "POSCO's growth is Pohang's growth, and Pohang's development is POSCO's competitiveness. As the steel industry faces new challenges, Pohang City and POSCO must cooperate more closely to create new growth engines." (박 당선인은 “포스코의 성장이 곧 포항의 성장이고 포항 발전이 곧 포스코의 경쟁력이다. 철강 산업이 새로운 도전에 직면한 만큼 포항시와 포스코가 더 긴밀히 협력해 새로운 성장 동력을 만들어가야 한다”고 했다.)

He added, "Together with People Power Party lawmakers Kim Jeong-jae and Lee Sang-hwi, and North Gyeongsang Province Governor Lee Cheol-woo, I will actively push for the swift implementation of a special law to strengthen the competitiveness of the steel industry and transition to carbon neutrality, as well as a reduction in industrial electricity rates." (이어 “김정재·이상휘 국민의힘 의원, 이철우 경북지사 등과 함께 철강 산업 경쟁력 강화와 탄소 중립 전환을 위한 특별법의 조속한 시행과 산업용 전기 요금 인하를 적극 추진하겠다”고 말했다.)

Earlier in the day, before the meeting, he visited the Pohang Memorial Tower for the War Dead alongside elected officials including lawmakers Kim Jeong-jae (Pohang North District) and Lee Sang-hwi (Pohang South District and Ulleung), as well as provincial and city councilors-elect. (그는 이날 면담에 앞서 김정재 의원(포항 북구)·이상휘 의원(포항 남구·울릉)을 비롯한 경북도의원·포항시의원 당선인과 함께 포항 충혼탑을 참배했다.)
